verify_email.subject: Verify your email
verify_email.title: Verify your email address
verify_email.body:
Hello {firstName},

Thank you for signing up. Confirm your email address by clicking the button below. This link is valid for 24 hours.

If you did not sign up, please ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.title: Password reset
password_reset.body:
Hello {firstName},

We received a request to reset the password of your account. This link is valid for 1 hour and can be used only once. Once your new password is saved, all your sessions will be signed out.

If you did not request this, please ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.

email_change_confirm.subject: Confirm your email address change
email_change_confirm.title: Confirm your email address change
email_change_confirm.body:
Hello {firstName},

A request was made to replace the email address of your account with {newEmail}. For security reasons, the change must be confirmed from both the old and the new address. This link is valid for 24 hours.

If you did not make this request, please ignore this email and change your password.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.title: Password changed
password_changed.body:
Hello {firstName},

The password of your account was just changed.

If you did not make this change, reset your password immediately and contact support.

email_changed.subject: The email address of your account was changed
email_changed.title: Email address changed
email_changed.body:
Hello {firstName},

The email address of your account is now {newEmail}. Future emails will be sent to this address.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

new_device.subject: New sign-in to your account
new_device.title: Sign-in from a new device
new_device.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account was signed in from a new device:
{device} — IP address {ip}

If this was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, change your password and sign out your sessions from the security settings.

token_reuse.subject: Suspicious activity: your sessions were signed out
token_reuse.title: Suspicious activity detected
token_reuse.body:
Hello {firstName},

We detected the reuse of a session token that had already been used, which may indicate a stolen session. As a precaution, the affected sessions were signed out.

Sign in again and, if you do not recognise this activity, change your password.

account_locked.subject: Your account is temporarily locked
account_locked.title: Account temporarily locked
account_locked.body:
Hello {firstName},

After several failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

If this was not you, change your password as soon as the lock ends.

2fa_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled
2fa_enabled.title: Two-factor authentication enabled
2fa_enabled.body:
Hello {firstName},

Two-factor authentication is now enabled on your account. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

2fa_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication disabled
2fa_disabled.title: Two-factor authentication disabled
2fa_disabled.body:
Hello {firstName},

Two-factor authentication was disabled on your account: it is now protected by your password only.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used
recovery_code_used.title: Recovery code used

otp_dev.subject: Your phone verification code (development)
otp_dev.title: Phone verification code
otp_dev.body:
Your verification code is: {otpCode}

It is valid for 10 minutes. This email replaces the text message in development environments only.

ownership_transferred.subject: Ownership of the workspace {workspaceName} was transferred
ownership_transferred.title: Workspace ownership transferred
ownership_transferred.body:
Hello {firstName},

Ownership of the workspace “{workspaceName}” was transferred. The roles of the previous and the new owner were updated; you can review them in the workspace settings.

report_received.subject: We received your report
report_received.title: Report received
report_received.body:
Hello {firstName},

Thank you for your report. Our moderation team will review it as soon as possible and take the necessary action.

For confidentiality reasons, we may not always be able to share the details of the action taken.

new_report.subject: New report to review
new_report.title: New report
new_report.body: A new report was submitted and is awaiting your review.

minor_safety_reminder.subject: Reminder: minor safety report without a response
minor_safety_reminder.title: Minor safety report pending
minor_safety_reminder.body:
A report about the safety of a minor has not received a first response within the 24-hour deadline.

Please handle it as a priority.

user_suspended.subject: Your account was suspended
user_suspended.title: Account suspended
user_suspended.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account was suspended by the platform team.
Reason: {reason}

Your sessions were signed out. To appeal this decision, contact support.

user_unsuspended.subject: Your account was reactivated
user_unsuspended.title: Account reactivated
user_unsuspended.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account was reactivated. You can sign in and use the platform again.

received_student.subject: {inviterName} invites you to join {workspaceName}
received_student.title: Invitation to join {workspaceName}

received_staff.subject: {inviterName} invites you to join the {workspaceName} team
received_staff.title: Invitation to join the {workspaceName} team
received_staff.body:
Hello,

{inviterName} invites you to join the “{workspaceName}” organisation as {role, select, TEACHER {a teacher} ADMIN {an administrator} other {a member}}.

This invitation is valid until {expiresAt}. It is reserved for this email address: please do not forward it.

If you do not know {inviterName}, ignore this email.

accepted.subject: {memberName} joined {workspaceName}
accepted.title: Invitation accepted
accepted.body:
Hello {firstName},

{memberName} accepted your invitation to join the “{workspaceName}” space. You can follow their status from your space.

consent_requested.subject: {studentName} would like to join {teacherName}’s space
consent_requested.title: Parental consent requested
consent_requested.body:
Hello,

{studentName} would like to join the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName} to take online courses and live video sessions. As {studentName} is under 18, your consent is required before any access.

You can grant or refuse this request from the page below, without creating an account. This link is valid until {expiresAt}.

Your consent applies to this space only, and you can withdraw it at any time.

If you are not the parent or legal guardian of {studentName}, ignore this email.

consent_confirmation.subject: Your consent for {studentName} is recorded
consent_confirmation.title: Thank you, your consent is recorded
consent_confirmation.body:
Hello,

You have allowed {studentName} to use the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}.

The link below gives you access to the list of {studentName}’s sessions in this space and lets you withdraw your consent at any time. This link is personal: do not forward it to anyone.

Withdrawing your consent suspends {studentName}’s access to this space only.

consent_granted.subject: You now have access to {workspaceName}
consent_granted.title: Parental consent granted
consent_granted.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your parent or guardian has given their consent: you can now access the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}.

consent_granted_teacher.subject: Parental consent granted for {studentName}
consent_granted_teacher.title: Parental consent granted
consent_granted_teacher.body:
Hello {firstName},

The parent or guardian of {studentName} has given their consent. {studentName} now has access to the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}.

consent_refused.subject: Parental consent refused — {workspaceName}
consent_refused.title: Parental consent refused
consent_refused.body:
Hello {firstName},

{recipientRole, select, STUDENT {Your parent or guardian has refused your use of the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}. Your access to this space remains suspended. You can talk it over with them and send the request again from the space.} other {The parent or guardian of {studentName} has refused consent for the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}. {studentName}’s access to this space remains suspended; you can send the request again from their profile.}}
consent_refused.cta: {recipientRole, select, STUDENT {Open the space} other {View the student’s profile}}

consent_revoked.subject: Parental consent withdrawn — {workspaceName}
consent_revoked.title: Parental consent withdrawn
consent_revoked.body:
Hello {firstName},

{recipientRole, select, STUDENT {Your parent or guardian has withdrawn their consent for the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}. Your access to this space is suspended; your other spaces are not affected and your data is kept.} other {The parent or guardian of {studentName} has withdrawn their consent for the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName}. {studentName}’s access to this space is suspended; their data is kept.}}
consent_revoked.cta: {recipientRole, select, STUDENT {Open the space} other {View the student’s profile}}

consent_expired.subject: Parental consent request expired — {workspaceName}
consent_expired.title: Consent request expired
consent_expired.body:
Hello {firstName},

{recipientRole, select, STUDENT {Your parent or guardian did not answer the consent request for the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName} within 14 days. Your access to this space is suspended; you can send the request again from the space.} other {The parent or guardian of {studentName} did not answer the consent request for the “{workspaceName}” space of {teacherName} within 14 days. {studentName}’s access to this space is suspended; you can send the request again from their profile.}}
consent_expired.cta: {recipientRole, select, STUDENT {Open the space} other {View the student’s profile}}

approved.subject: Your request to join {workspaceName} was accepted
approved.title: Request accepted
approved.body:

{teacherName} accepted your request to join the “{workspaceName}” space.

If you are under 18, your access will open as soon as your parent or guardian gives their consent: an email has been sent to them.

Processing of {filename} failed ({reason, select, ABANDONED {the upload was not finished within 24 hours} TIMEOUT {processing took too long} PROVIDER_ERROR {the video service could not process the file} INVALID_SIGNATURE {the file is unreadable or does not match its type} ENCRYPTED {the PDF is password-protected} QUOTA_EXCEEDED {the storage space is full} SIZE_MISMATCH {the file exceeds the allowed size or duration} other {unknown error}}). You can try uploading it again from the course editor.

terms.body:
These terms govern the use of {appName} by teachers, students and their parents.

They set out everyone’s rights and obligations, the rules for publishing courses and live sessions, and the conditions under which an account may be suspended.

The final version will be published here.

privacy.body:
This policy explains which data {appName} collects, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.

It covers in particular the data of minor students and their parents’ consent.

The final version will be published here.

codeOfConduct.body:
This code of conduct sets the rules of mutual respect in the courses, live sessions and messages of {appName}.

Any breach can be reported from the app and may lead to the suspension of an account.

The final version will be published here.

minors.body:
This notice explains to parents and guardians how {appName} handles the data of students under 18: which data is collected, who can see it and how long it is kept.

It also sets out the scope of parental consent: it is given for a single course space, can be withdrawn at any time from the follow-up link, and withdrawing it suspends access to that space without deleting any data.

The final version will be published here.
